hooks.command: if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -x "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"/scripts/orchestrator-priming.py ]; then exec "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"/scripts/orchestrator-priming.py; elif [ -n "${STRAW_BOSS_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -x "$STRAW_BOSS_PLUGIN_ROOT"/scripts/orchestrator-priming.py ]; then exec "$STRAW_BOSS_PLUGIN_ROOT"/scripts/orchestrator-priming.py; elif [ -x "$HOME"/.gemini/config/plugins/straw-boss/scripts/orchestrator-priming.py ]; then exec "$HOME"/.gemini/config/plugins/straw-boss/scripts/orchestrator-priming.py; fi; cat >/dev/null; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"straw-boss: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is unset or does not contain scripts/orchestrator-priming.py, so the orchestrator priming hook was skipped. Restart this session to reload plugin roots."}'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'; foreach ($root in @($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:STRAW_BOSS_PLUGIN_ROOT, (Join-Path $HOME '.gemini/config/plugins/straw-boss'))) { if ($root) { $script = Join-Path $root 'scripts/orchestrator-priming.py'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script -PathType Leaf) { & uv run --script $script; exit $LASTEXITCODE } } }; $null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); [Console]::Out.WriteLine('{\"systemMessage\":\"straw-boss: plugin root is unset or does not contain scripts/orchestrator-priming.py; hook skipped. Restart this session to reload plugin roots.\"}')"
